title: Research sprint goal: Lookup correctness: no clean good for questions the kb lacks, measured before and after, and a cold pack near its time before the freshness stamp
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: No outside facts: the sprint's three items change this repo's own pack verdict, its freshness-stamp reads and one benchmark report section; the kb already holds the retrieval facts they rest on (public/agents/hybrid-retrieval.md:182 and :190 on the off-kb false good and its QPP features, public/agents/doc-change-detection.md:168 on a fact's age, public/python/interpreter-startup.md on start-up cost), a pack of the sprint's questions returned good or weak on them with every missing word a repo-internal name (sc_absent, _anchors.csv, the cold-pack median), and the four sc_absent questions must stay absent, so no live-docs fetch and no kb fact or gap entry is written.
